summary: Gorax continues his Option Summons session targeting the Dauntless and Toxin damage schools to hit an exclusive Legendary hero. Along the way, he pulls several Legendaries including Divine Ascetic, Garett, Bionphray, and a third copy of Talwer, evaluating most of them as weak or fodder. He gets a useful Tharivol duplicate for inspiration and finally lands Lothair, an exclusive Legendary Toxin DPS hero.

heroes.name: Divine Ascetic
heroes.note: Considered rubbish by the creator and not worth using in serious builds.

heroes.name: Garett
heroes.note: Has a great visual design but performs uselessly in practice.

heroes.name: Bionphray
heroes.note: A non-exclusive support hero who offers minimal overall value.

heroes.name: Talwer
heroes.note: Often pulled as a duplicate and mostly used for artifact or exchange conversion.

heroes.name: Tharivol
heroes.note: Inspirations provide substantial damage bonuses against shielded enemies and improve overall stats.

heroes.name: Lothair
heroes.note: An exclusive Legendary hero that makes committing to a Toxin team worthwhile.

heroes.name: Durango
heroes.note: An essential hero for building and enabling effective Toxin team comps.

tips: Summon pity counters on Option Summons do not carry over between different banners, so avoid splitting pulls across banners.
Duplicate Legendary heroes can be converted into soul imprints for hero inspirations or traded for artifacts.
Adjust your selectable wishlist heroes to prioritize core enablers or high-impact inspirations like Sintrellia or Zeffi.
title: I Summoned Until an Exclusive Hero Dropped! | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
